name: 22406 · Fredericksbrg, VA
findings: ZIP 22406 (Fredericksbrg) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 23 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22406 (Fredericksbrg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 22406 (Fredericksbrg) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 67% of the typical level).
